facts.statement: The researchers studied adult patients with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease in Romania and France.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The study used a cross-sectional design to test the new questionnaire's reliability and ability to distinguish between different levels of disability.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The new tool measures four specific areas including symptoms, work impact, social life, and healthcare needs using a total of 38 items.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The questionnaire showed strong reliability in most areas, but the section on healthcare needs was less consistent among French participants.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Results indicated that the tool can detect differences in unmet needs based on the country's healthcare system.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The new questionnaire produced results that matched those from standard generic quality-of-life measures.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The authors note that the study needs confirmation in larger groups of patients before the tool is fully established.
facts.subject: humans
